title: Modding guide
html:
Mods replace the game's own models, pictures and sounds. They never change the game's files: the game keeps them apart and uses them while they are switched on. Mods hold no code: only models (.glb), pictures (.png, .jpg, .webp) and sounds (.ogg, .mp3, .wav). Anything else is refused when you install.

The Mod Manager

Open it from the start screen: Mods. It has four tabs:

  • Installed: your mods, in load order.
  • Switch each one on or off, drag to reorder, or turn all mods off at once.
  • Mark favourites and rate them.
  • Sort by load order, newest, recently updated, name, author, size, category, most downloaded or rating.
  • Filter by category, on/off, conflicts, updates, made for this version, official or community, and favourites.
  • Search by name, author or slot ID.
  • Browse: mods to get. For now this is demo content, marked Demo: it shows how mods work but has no files.
  • Slots: every replaceable thing, with its slot ID, file type, limits, scale and front direction, and which mod (if any) replaces it now.
  • Co-op: when you fly in co-op, it compares your mods with your partners'. It shows "You both have…", "Your partner has a mod you don't" and "Only you have". Mods only change how things look on your own device, so you can fly together with different mods.

Each mod's details page shows:

  • its description, screenshots and author
  • its version and the game version it was made for
  • its size, date and changelog
  • what it needs (dependencies)
  • the slot IDs it replaces, each with Preview: the game's own model beside the replacement, turning

Other tools:

  • Profiles save which mods are on, and their order, under a name.
  • Undo steps back through your last 20 changes.
  • Health check finds:
  • missing files
  • slots no longer in the game
  • mods made for another game version
  • missing or switched-off dependencies
  • conflicts

Conflicts

When two switched-on mods replace the same slot, the one lower in the load order is used. To change that, open either mod's details and choose Use this one for that slot.

Installing

  • PC: put .zip packages in Documents\Airline Manager Pro\Mods. New and changed ones are installed each time the Mod Manager opens (Mods folder opens that folder). Or use Install a .zip.
  • Phone: Open a .zip and pick the package.

A newer version of a mod you have (same id) replaces the old one and keeps its place and its on/off setting.

Making a mod

A mod is a .zip with mod.json at the top (or inside a single folder), and the files it names:

{
  "id": "nordic-ramp-trucks",
  "name": "Nordic ramp trucks",
  "author": "Your name",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "game": "0.9.154",
  "category": "vehicles",
  "description": "What it is.",
  "files": {
    "vehicles/fuel-truck": "fuel-truck.glb",
    "vehicles/catering-truck": "catering-truck.glb"
  },
  "depends": [],
  "changelog": ["1.0.0: first version"],
  "screenshots": ["shot-1.jpg"]
}
FieldWhat it is
idNever changes between versions. 3 to 64 small letters, digits, dots or dashes.
versionLike 1.0.0. A higher version replaces the lower one.
gameThe game version you made it with. Older versions of the same series are accepted (with a note).
categoryaircraft, helicopters, vehicles, people, buildings, props, items, security or effects.
filesSlot ID → file in the package. The slot IDs are listed in the Mod Manager's Slots tab and in www/models/README.md.
dependsOther mods' ids this one needs.
screenshotsUp to 6 pictures (each under 2 MB) shown on the details page.

What each kind of slot must be

KindFileLimitScale and front
Aircraft.glb40 MB, 300,000 trianglesMetres, real size; nose towards +Z
Helicopters.glb30 MB, 200,000 trianglesMetres, real size; nose towards +Z
Vehicles.glb15 MB, 100,000 trianglesMetres; front towards +Z, wheels on the ground
People.glb20 MB, 80,000 trianglesFitted to each person's height; facing +Z; Idle and Walk clips and a jaw bone are used
Buildings.glb60 MB, 400,000 trianglesMetres; doors towards +Z
Props and furniture.glb5 MB, 30,000 trianglesMetres, standing on the floor; front towards +Z
Items.glb2 MB, 10,000 trianglesMetres; label towards +Z
Security.glb3 MB, 15,000 trianglesMetres; towards +Z
Effects.png4 MBUp to 2048 × 2048, transparent background

Pack everything into the .glb: textures must be inside it, not separate files it points to. Each model is fitted to the size of the game's own, so a slightly different size still fits.
